The game was a friendly, and it was just nine months since the two teams had played at the World Cup. The match was played at the Juventus Stadium, and many people expected England to win because they had won their last seven games. However, England’s coach, Roy Hodgson, had a difficult time in the first half. Italy scored first when Graziano Pelle headed the ball into the net. The final score was 1-1. During the game, Rooney, who is the captain of England, told his teammates what to do. Rooney said that he and the rest of the team were upset with how they played in the first half.

Dundee United’s board responded to strong criticism from two major supporters' groups, Arabtrust and the Federation of Dundee United Supporters Clubs. The groups are upset that 25 percent of the £6.3 million paid for players Ryan Gauld, Andrew Robertson, Stuart Armstrong, and Gary Mackay-Steven went to unnamed third parties as commissions. They also also questioned chairman Stephen Thompson’s claimed level of investment in the club. The board defended their performance by pointing to the team’s success on the field.

Kilmarnock will make an official announcement on Friday morning that Gary Locke is their new permanent manager. Locke, 39, will receive a three-year contract. This happens exactly eight weeks after he was asked to take charge of the team until the season ends. Locke, who previously managed Hearts, replaces Allan Johnston, who was the temporary manager starting in February. On Thursday, Locke thanked the players for their hard work, which helped him gain the support of the club’s new chairman, Jim Mann.

Chinese parents are very eager to raise child prodigies, such 10-year-olds who enter university or 4-year-olds who can dance like Michael Jackson. A new basketball star is emerging. A viral video in China shows a young boy with amazing basketball skills that rival many professional players. The boy, five-year-old Mai Zizhuo, has been playing basketball since he was two and half. People’s Daily Online reported this. The video shows the small boy making many baskets, then dribbling two basketballs at the same time while running.

Bayern Munich will not have David Alaba for the last games of the season. Alaba has a torn knee ligament and will be out for about seven weeks. He hurt his knee while playing for Austria in a 1-1 tie against Bosnia on Tuesday. Alaba, 22, said he is very sad but his goal is to play in the final game of the season. This injury happened after he was tackled by Emir Spahic. Alaba had already missed three months earlier this season because of a partial tear in his right knee.

Hull KR has signed experienced Australian player Dane Tilse from the Canberra Raiders to fill the spot left by the retirement of Michael Weyman and the departure of Ryan Bailey. Tilse, 30, stands 6ft 7in and weighs over 17 pounds. He has signed a two-and-a-half-year contract with Hull KR. He will join the team as soon as he finishes the necessary paperwork after the Raiders agreed to release him. Tilse has played 200 games in Australia. He will work with his old teammate Terry Campese, who is now the captain of Hull KR and recently signed a two-year contract extension. Tilse is a direct replacement for Weyman, who retired last month due to injury.

Mark Burchill, the manager of Livingston football team, thinks that midfielder Darren Cole wants to play in the Petrofac Cup final this Sunday. This game is only one week after the sad death of his cousin, Shaun Cole. Shaun was 22 years. He was found dead on a street in Miami, last weekend. People think a driver hit him and drove away. Shaun was a soldier who had served in Afghanistan. He was on holiday in Florida while on leave. He had been to a music festival there. Then he was found on the sidewalk with a head injury. This injury caused his death. Mark Burchill hopes that Darren Cole will play for his team on Sunday.

Alan Smith strongly denies that Liverpool fans attacked the ambulance he was in after he was seriously injured. The incident happened nine years ago during Manchester United’s 1-0 loss to Liverpool in the FA Cup. Smith broke his leg and dislocated his ankle while trying to stop a free kick from John Arne Riise at Anfield in February 206. At the time, reports said that fans threw bottles, beer glasses, and stones at the ambulance and tried to rock it. WARNING GRAPHIC CONTENT.

Ronny Deila, the manager of Celtic, confirmed that the club is interested in signing Danny Wilson, the captain of Hearts. Celtic might offer £400,000 for him. Wilson, who has played for Rangers and Liverpool, has one year left on his contract with Hearts. Hearts’ owner, Ann Budge, says the club does not need to sell players.

Ronny Deila, the manager of Celtic, says the team will not risk their chances in the Champions League by playing many away games during pre-season. He blames last summer’s tour of the United States, Austria, and Germany for a 4-1 loss to Legia Warsaw in the qualifying round. Celtic has been paid large amounts of money to play in these pre-season games, including trips to Australia and Asia in recent years. Whether the team will return to America this July has not yet been decided.

Franck Ribery says that rumors about Kevin de Bruyne joining Bayern Munich are wrong. De Bruyne is a forward for Wolfsburg. Some people think he could replace Ribery or his teammate Arjen Robben. De Bruyne played at Chelsea for two years, mostly on loan, before moving to Wolfsburg. Wolfsburg is second in the league. De Bruyne has scored nine goals this season. He also has the most assists in the league with 16. This is seven more than the next best player. Ribery says De Bruyne is not the right fit for Pep Guardiola. Ribery says De Bruyne plays differently than him and Robben.

Kelsi Langley, the girlfriend of Arizona State University football player Davon Durant, has taken back her accusation that he abused her. she says she lied because she had mood swings. Durant, a talented linebacker, was arrested for domestic violence after Langley said he hit her in the face and grabbed her neck during an argument in his car on March 7. because of the arrest, Durant, who transferred to ASU from a college in Kansas and was highly recruited, has been suspended from the team indefinitely and might be expelled from the university.

A young boy met his hero, Detroit Tigers pitcher Justin Verlander, at a Starbucks. The boy was wearing a dark blue shirt with Verlander’s name and jersey number, 35, on the back. Verlander took a selfie with the boy, and later posted the photo on his Instagram account.

Eden Hazard admitted that playing so many games for Chelsea and his national team this season might have been too much for him. he was substituted after just 62 minutes during Belgium’s 1-0 win over Israel on Tuesday. Hazard played 48 games this season for his club and his country, only missing five matches for Chelsea. He played in every Barclays Premier League game as Chelsea won the title. However, during Belgium’s difficult 1-0 victory over Israel in the European Championship qualifying, manager Marc Wilmots took him off with 28 minutes left. Hazard had struggled to beat his defender, Orel Dgani.

Police in the Northern Territory found 20 grams of marijuana hidden inside a leg of lamb. The meat was sent to a company at Darwin Airport, and it was supposed to be shipped to the Tiwi Islands, 100 kilometers to the north. The police noticed a strange smell, so they x-rayed the lamb and found the drugs inside.

Former football player Clarke Carlisle has announced that he and his wife, Gemma, are separating. He has moved out of their home in Yorkshire, where they lived for 14 years. Carlisle is struggling with depression after a failed suicide attempt in December. This happened two days after he was arrested for suspected drunk driving.

Paul Merson, a former Arsenal player, was forced to take back his comments after criticizing Andros Townsend’s call-up to the England team. Merson admitted he was wrong. Townsend, who plays for Tottenham, came off the bench and scored a amazing goal to tie the game 1-1 against Italy in Turin on Tuesday. This was a perfect response to Merson, who had written in his Sky Sports column that if Townsend could make the team, then anyone could. Townsend celebrated his goal with his teammates Ryan Mason and Kyle Walker.

Cesc Fabregas, a midfielder for Chelsea, has a reputation for playing poorly in the second half of the season. He was one of the worst players on the field again when his country, Spain, lost 2-0 to Holland on Tuesday. The 27-year-old was happy to play in southwest London earlier this week, but his performance has dropped significantly. At Christmas, he looked like he would break the Premier League record for assists.

West Midlands Police arrested six people in Dover this morning. They are suspected of terrorism offenses related to Syria. Five men and one woman were taken into custody around 8 a.m. at the port’s departure area. Four of the men, who are in their 20s, are from Birmingham, in the West Midlands. The other two suspects are a 26-year-old man and a 23-year-old woman who do not have a fixed address. The six suspects are currently being questioned at a police station in the West Midlands.

People are likely to buy treats today at 12:52 pm. A study says that people in Britain spend an average of £62 a week on things that make them feel good. This shopping time is called "retail therapy." The time when people most often buy things is at lunchtime today. The things people buy can be small, like a chocolate bar or a glass of wine. They can also be expensive, like designer clothes and shoes. This information comes from the website VoucherCodes.co.uk. The study also says that men spend one-third more money each month on treats than women do.

Arsene Wenger is very respected and known for being smart. When he speaks, people often agree with him. But, when you look closely, his ideas are not always well-supported. He often talks about how Arsenal’s defense is actually very good, after a recent bad performance. Last week, he spoke about a new rule suggested by Greg Dyke, the head of the Football Association. Dyke wants to increase the number of home-ggrown players in a Premier League team from 8 to 12.

Charlie Austin said that his close friend Joey Barton ignored him on his first day at Queens Park Rangers. Barton realized his mistake, and the two became good friends. Austin had a great first season in the Premier League, scoring 15 goals. people think he might play for England in the future. everyone knows that Austin and Barton, who is the team captain, are close friends. But their first meeting was something Austin will never forget.

This dog is his owner’s best friend because he saved him from a cold, muddy grave. The black dog was filmed bringing a rescue rope to his owner at the Clarence J. Brown Dam and Reservoir in Springfield, Ohio, on Saturday afternoon. The man was pulled to shore by firefighters after spending nearly two hours in water that was near zero degrees Celsius. He had gotten stuck waist deep in mud while trying to get his duck hunting gear. He was lucky to have a cell phone to call 911. First responders could not send a boat because the river was too shallow.

Juventus coach Massimiliano Allegri says he knows that the fans won’t fully support him until the team wins a championship. He took the job last summer, a few months after leaving AC Milan. Since he started, he has done well. He has led Juventus to the top of the Serie A league. The team replaced Antonio Conte last summer. On Saturday, Juventus will play Empoli at home and try to win three more points.

Nathan Redmond scored the winning goal just six minutes into the match. Steven Whittaker passed the ball to Redmond along the right side of the field. Redmond ran faster than Joe Bennett and crossed the ball to Bradley Johnson, who scored from the back of the goal. Johnson celebrated after scoring the second-half winning goal at the Amex Stadium.

The residents of Celoron, New York, are upset about a statue of Lucille Ball, a famous person from their town. The statue has not been popular for the last six years. The town opened the statue in 2009. The face on the statue looks nothing like the funny actress that people she loved. The locals are shocked and horrified by how it looks. The statue looks so bad that a Facebook page called "We Love Lucy! Get Rid of this Statue" has more than 600 people who like it. The statue is based on a famous scene from her TV show "I Love Lucy." In the scene, she is drunk and selling a health drink.

South Sydney rugby league player Issac Luke, 27, is facing accusations of being homophobic. He posted an offensive comment on social media after being attacked by fans of the Canterbury Bulldogs. Luke had previously posted a heartfelt message on his official Instagram account on Saturday, asking for help to find a young South Sydney fan who was allegedly attacked at ANZ Stadium in Sydney. The player wanted to donate a jersey to the boy before the Easter long weekend as a way to make up for the incident, which left the boy hospitalized after a controversial game.

People who are afraid of spiders, watch out. this story is scary. A man in Victoria, Australia, was very surprised when a large huntsman spider came out from inside his car door handle. The video was made in Wangaratta, in the northeast part of Victoria. The video starts with the man walking up to his black Holden Ute. He sprays insect repell on the door. This makes the huntsman spider come out from under the door handle. The man says, "Get out, you bastard." He tries to stay calm. But when the hairy spider's legs come out, he yells and steps back in fear.

Tottenham’s manager, Mauricio Pochettino, says that Harry Kane is like Gabriel Batistuta, a famous soccer player. Pochettino promised to support Kane when he having difficult times. Kane scored a goal just 79 seconds after he came into the game against Lithuania at Wembley on Friday night. This goal put him very close to scoring 30 goals this season. This was his first game for the England national team. England’s manager, Roy Hodgson, wants to keep expectations for Kane realistic. Kane has risen quickly in his career. This happened after he finally joined the Tottenham first team, following previous loans to Leicester and Norwich. Mauricio Pochettino compared Harry Kane to Gabriel Batistuta.

A former professional footballer, Michael McIndoe, who played for Bristol City and Wolverhampton Wanderers, is now living in poverty. a court was told. McIndoe ran a investment scheme that took in £30 million. He promised people a 20% profit. He convinced other footballers to join. The scheme failed because he had too much debt. McIndoe went bankrupt last October with over £2 million in debt. At the time, he lived like a millionaire in Marbella, Spain, partying with attractive women. People called him "Mr Big." Now, people he owes money to are trying to get paid through the legal system.

Pavel Nedved, a director at Juventus, said that Barcelona wants to sign Paul Pogba. Nedved gave an interview to the newspaper Mundo Deportivo. He said that Pogba will not leave Juventus. Nedved also said he was happy that Juventus did not play against Barcelona in the quarter-finals of the Champions League.

James Oliver, 44, is a convicted sex offender. Linda Currier, 53, is his girlfriend. She allegedly hit him with her car after she saw him trying to abuse a 12-year-old girl. Police found Oliver with a serious leg injury in the driveway of a house in Noblesboro, Maine, on Saturday night.

The police say that Currier and Oliver argued inside the house. The argument happened after Currier caught Oliver trying to sexually assault the young girl.

Brendan Rodgers, the manager of Liverpool, wants to sign a goalkeeper named Neto from Fiorentina. PSG (Paris Saint-Germain) and several clubs in Spain also want to sign him. Neto’s agent, Stefano Castagna, said that Rodgers has strong competition for the player.

Neto is 25 years old. His contract with Fiorentina ends in June. Earlier this season, Liverpool was interested in signing him because their usual goalkeeper, Simon Mignolet, was not playing well. Liverpool tried to sign Neto in January, but the deal did not happen. Now, it seems very likely that Neto will leave Fiorentina in the summer.

A video by YouTuber Richard Stewart shows a Porsche Cayman losing control on Prince Edward Island, Canada. The car speeds away from a green light, swerves wildly, and crashes into a concrete median. A wheel flies off before the car stops. Stewart says, "Just because you have a nice car doesn't make you a good driver. Don't let your son drive your Porsche."

This weekend, Sportsmail will provide information for every Premier League game, including team news, possible lineups, betting odds, and statistics from Opta. Here is the information for Sunderland’s home game against Newcastle at the Stadium of Light. Sunderland midfielder Lee Cattermole will return to the starting team for Sunday’s match against Newcastle. Head coach Dick Advocaat confirmed that Cattermole is back after serving a two-game ban for receiving his tenth booking of the season.

If Rory McIlroy wins the upcoming Masters, it will make him the first golfer to win all four major championships. This achievement will the end of a long journey for the world’s top golfer. He and his sponsor, Bose, have made a video about his life. The video shows how he started playing golf as a child and eventually became a star, including some difficult times. The video starts with McIlroy going for a run early in the morning. The words “Six weeks to Georgia” appear on the screen. The video also includes an interview with McIlroy when he was young, before he became famous.

Sergio Garcia says he is only thinking about winning his first PGA Tour event since 2012 at this week’s Shell Houston Open. The Masters golf tournament is coming up soon, but he wants to focus on ending his long wait for a victory. Many people are talking about Rory McIlroy trying to win three big tournaments in a row, and about whether Tiger Woods will return to playing after staying away for a while. These topics have been the main news for weeks. The Golf Club of Houston is set up to look like the course at Augusta, where the Masters is held. but Garcia is just focused on winning.

Riki Hughes, a 31-year-old Iraq war veteran, went to jail for 16 months. He worked as a volunteer club secretary for Tidworth Town Football Club. He stole £17,000 from the club. He said he was paying rent for the club’s building, but the team was actually getting the building for free. Hughes used the money for himself. he bought camping gear and went on a stag holiday to Las Vegas.

Johnny Sexton is used to winning. He has won many gold medals and now he wants to keep winning. He prepared for a big game against Saracens in Paris on Sunday. Sexton plays for Racing Metro and he is famous in Ireland. He said, “I was lucky to play with great teams for Leinster and Ireland. Most years, my team won trophies. The 29-year-old has been a senior player since 2010. The year 22010 was the only year where he did not win big awards.”

Mustafa Kamal stepped down as president of the International Cricket Council (ICC) on Wednesday. He is from Bangladesh. He said that India had influence in the ICC and used that power to change the result of the quarter-final match between Bangladesh and India. He spoke at the airport when he returned from the tournament in Australia. Kamal said that everyone saw what happened during the Bangladesh-India match. He said India used its position in the ICC to influence the outcome. He added that he would have done the same if it had happened to any other country. Now, he is no longer the ICC president. A picture shows him with the Cricket World Cup trophy.

West Ham manager Sam Allardyce supports Nigel Pearson, the manager of Leicester City. Allardyce thinks Pearson is independent and strong-minded. Allardyce worked with Pearson at Newcastle United in 2007. The two men will working together again when West Ham plays Leicester on Saturday at the King Power Stadium. Pearson has been involved in several controversial incidents this season, including grabbing Crystal Palace's James McArthur by the throat and losing his cool with a reporter during a press conference.

Sunderland’s manager, John O'Shea, told his team to take control of their fate by beating Newcastle for the fifth game in a row. The two teams play at the Stadium of Light on Sunday. Sunderland has won the last four games against Newcastle, but they desperately need three points to avoid being relegated from the Premier League. O'Shea and his players could find themselves in the releg zone if Burnley beats Tottenham in the earlier game that day. So, getting three points is very important.

Stoke City manager Mark Hughes believes his team should finally win a game at Chelsea’s stadium, Stamford Bridge. Since Stoke promoted to the Premier League in 2008, they have played Chelsea away eight times and lost every time. The last time Stoke won at Chelsea was in 1995, when they won a League Cup match. The last time Stoke got even a point (a draw) was in 1984. Hughes says his team must end this losing streak. Chelsea recently beat Stoke 3-0, with Frank Lampard celebrating the win.

Newcastle United wants to avoid losing their third game in a row when they play their rivals, Sunderland, on Sunday. They have been having a hard time lately because their striker, Papiss Cisse, is banned. Dick Advocaat’s team is near the bottom of the English Premier League, just one point above the teams that might have to leave the league. But if it weren’t for Papiss Cisse, they would be two points further behind. Cisse is the best scorer for Newcastle this year with 11 goals. 10 of those goals helped his team win games.

Dick Advocaat, the manager of Sunderland, is happy to have Lee Cattermole back playing in the middle of the team. He wants to use this chance to stay in the league. Sunderland is trying to win their fifth derby game in a row. Cattermole, 27, is known for being tough on the field. He missed the last two games because he was suspended. He had received 10 yellow cards this season. Because he was suspended, he could not play in Advocaat’s first game as manager. Sunderland lost that game 1–0 to West Ham on March 21. Cattermole was the only player told he would definitely start against Newcastle on Sunday. Advocaat spoke to the team on Friday. Advocaat

Ronny Deila, the manager of Celtic, says that getting into the Champions League is not just about money. But there are 16 million reasons for him to leading the team to a fourth straight league title. These reasons are all about money. This week, UEFA ( the organization that runs European soccer) announced how much money teams will get for the next three years of the Champions League. The last time Celtic played in the main stage of the Champions League was in 2213-14. They played against AC Milan, Ajax, and Barcelona. They won one game and earned £12.6 million. If they do the same ( or better) next season, they will get £4 million more. If they reach the last 16 teams, they will

Tottenham defender Ben Davies is focused on the game and not on personal feelings when he plays against his Wales teammate, Sam Vokes, at Burnley on Sunday. Tottenham’s manager, Mauricio Pochettino, wants to keep up their good form. They have only lost one of their last four Premier League games, that loss being to Manchester United. They are trying to stay in the race for a spot in European competitions. Burnley, meanwhile, is fighting to avoid being relegated. They are currently in 18th place, but only one point away from safety. Earlier this season, in the FA Cup, Sam Vokes scored for Burnley against Tottenham. Ben Davies, who plays for Tottenham, looked upset after Burnley tied the game.

Neil Redfearn, the manager of Leeds United, is thinking about staying in his job. this is because the club suspended his assistant, Steve Thompson, on Thursday. The club took two months to hire Thompson, but he was told in a letter from director of football Nicola Salerno yesterday morning that he is suspended until the end of the season. This effectively ends his time at the club after only 105 days. Thompson was told he will be suspended until his contract ends at the end of the season. He was also told that the club will not use the option to extend his contract. Leeds United assistant manager Steve Thompson (left) has been suspended by the club.

John Carver says he will push his Newcastle players hard if he has to, to get them ready for Sunday’s game against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light. Newcastle has lost the last four games against Sunderland. Carver was Alan Pardew’s assistant during those losses. he admits that Sunderland wanted to win more than Newcastle did. “In the last four games, Sunderland worked harder than us. That is not a good thing,” he said.

David Templeton, a player for Rangers, said that the previous coaches, Ally McCoist and Kenny McDowall, did not good enough job training the team. He said that Stuart McCall, the new coach, has brought new ideas and tactics that were missing before. Templeton likes how McCall has helped the team since he started last month. The team has won two games in a row, which has made the players feel more confident before they play Hearts on Saturday. Templeton thinks McCall has done a great job.

Celta Vigo player Nolito says Lionel Messi should stay home from the game on Sunday instead of risking hurting his foot again. Messi has been practicing with his minor foot problem, and he should be ready to play when Barcelona goes to Celta. Nolito told Marca, "I think he will come, but I wish he would just spend the day at the beach. I will call his dad soon." Even so, Messi is expected to be healthy enough to play against Celta Vigo. On Thursday, Messi practiced with his teammate Javier Mascherano.

Hearts manager Robbie Neilson says that players like captain Danny Wilson will only leave the club if it is the right decision for the team. Sportsmail reported this week that Celtic is interested in signing Wilson, a former Rangers defender. Neilson admitted that other teams showing interest in his players is normal. He spoke before Hearts plays Celtic on Sunday. Neilson agrees with owner Ann Budge that players will only be sold if he approves and the price is right.

Sam Allardyce, the manager of West Ham, told Brendan Rodgers, the manager of Liverpool, that giving Raheem Sterling a very high-paying new contract might cause problems for the other Liverpool players. Allardyce thinks that if Sterling gets paid more than the £100,000 per week he was previously offered, his teammates will ask for higher salaries too. However, Allardyce does not blame Sterling for trying to get the best deal possible. Sterling currently earns £30,000 a week at Liverpool. Allardyce believes that because there are so few talented young players available, clubs are willing to pay huge amounts of money to sign them. Raheem Sterling, who plays for both Liverpool and England, has not yet signed a new contract with Liverpool

Blackpool Football Club is talking to Thomas Piermayr, a 25 defender from Austria, about signing him. He has been training with the team this week. Blackpool wants him to join them for the upcoming season, which they expect to spend in League One. Piermayr is currently without a club, because his previous team, the Colorado Rapids, has released him. He used to play for Inverness Caledonian Thistle in 211. Although he has never played in England, Blackpool might be his first opportunity to do so.

Tony Pulis plans to talk with West Bromwich Albion chairman Jeremy Peace after the team is safe from relegation in the Premier League. Pulis wants the club to become a top-ten team again. He said that West Brom has "gone off the rails" in recent years and needs major changes to improve. The team finished 10th and 8th under managers Roy Hodgson and Steve Clarke. Last season was chaotic, and they barely avoided relegation, finishing 17th. Tony Pulis, the manager of West Bromwich Albion, was seen shouting instructions from the sideline during a match against Manchester City.

Arsenal legend Ian Wright is upset that Theo Walcott is leaving north London. Wright thinks Walcott’s struggles at the club are because manager Arsene Wenger refused to play him as a striker. Walcott has only started five games for Arsenal this season after returning from a serious knee injury that missed seven months. With Arsenal looking at signing Raheem Sterling and Walcott’s contract ending next summer, Wright is worried the team might lose a valuable player.

Roberto Martinez, the manager of Everton, believes Ross Barkley will become a more important player for both his club and the England national team. after overcoming a difficult period. Barkley had a mixed season for Everton. He was named in England’s World Cup squad last summer, but then had knee surgery, which delayed his return to playing. Even so, England’s coach, Roy Hodgson, still trusts the 21-year-old. Martinez says Barkley’s two recent appearances as a substitute for England against Lithuania and Italy show that he is ready to improve his performance.

England’s Under-19 soccer team will not play in the European Championships this summer. They lost 2-1 to France in their final qualifying match. The Young Lions had already won against Denmark and Azerbaijan earlier in the tournament. They needed to beat France in Saint-Lo, France, to advance to the finals in Greece in July. However, goals from Sehrou Guirassy and Gnaly Cornet gave France the lead. England’s Patrick Roberts scored a late goal, but it was not enough for coach Sean O’Driscoll’s team to win.

Jonas Gutierrez, a 31-year-old midfielder for Newcastle, wants to help his team beat Sunderland, their rivals, in an important upcoming match. Gutierrez has recently returned to playing after recovering from testicular cancer. He has played as a substitute in the last three games, but Newcastle lost all of them. The fans have welcomed him back warmly. Gutierrez is eager to win a game after four straight losses, including the recent defeats. Newcastle will play Sunderland on Sunday at Sunderland's home stadium, the Stadium of Light.

During a close rugby league match on Good Friday at ANZ Stadium in Sydney, South Sydney (the Rabbitohs) beat Canterbury (the Bulldogs) 18-17 with a last-minute try. The game was controversial because of a decision by referee Gerard Sutton and his team. They penalized Bulldogs captain James Graham in the final moments, which allowed South Sydney to win.

 After the game, as the referees, officials, and players were leaving the field, some angry fans threw plastic water bottles and shouted insults at them.

Kevin Sinfield, the former captain of the England rugby league team, was told that he will be a "target" when he moves to rugby union. Sinfield, 34, is considered the greatest captain in Leeds Rhinos' history. He surprised the rugby league world on Tuesday by announcing that he will leave the sport at the end of the season. He will join Yorkshire Carnegie, the sister club of the Rhinos, on an 18-month contract.

Raheem Sterling said he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool. despite being offered £100,000 a week. The 20-year-old player seems close to leaving the club. He told the BBC that he would have signed for less money a year ago. However, he has not played as well as he did last season. This season, he has scored only six goals—one fewer than Stoke’s Jon Walters. his scoring rate and goals per minute have gotten worse, as shown in the graphic.

Brighton and Hove Albion, a football team in the Championship league, is the first club to offer legal and ethical training on sexual consent to its young players. The BBC reported that the club also provides counseling. The program, called Protect, Inform and Prevent (PIP), teaches players what the law says about giving consent. The training includes private question-and-answer sessions where players can discuss past experiences. It is led by a former police detective and a psychotherist.

A new video made by Leo Burnett Toronto for the charity Humans For Humans shows homeless people reading mean tweets about themselves. The video is meant to make people think twice about how they treat homeless people. Many of the people in the video cry as they read comments like, "I hate the homeless, I don’t feel sorry for you," and "I saw a homeless girl across the street. I almost vomited."

George Boyd is the most active player in the Barclays Premier League this season. He has run a total of 210.5 miles on the field. This distance is the same as running from Burnley’s Turf Moor stadium to Crystal Palace’s Selhurst Park stadium in south London. Boyd has run further than Christian Eriksen, who plays for Tottenham Hotspur. According to Google Maps, walking this distance would normally take 69 hours. Boyd has covered this distance in less than 40 hours of playing time.

Police in Birmingham have arrested the parents of a five-month-old baby girl after she died. The father, 25, and the mother, 25, live in Perry Barr, Birmingham. They were taken into custody after their daughter passed away yesterday afternoon.

The police were called to their home just before 1 a.m. yesterday because the baby was having trouble breathing. The baby was taken to Birmingham Children's Hospital, but she died a few hours later.

A police spokesman said the death is being treated as suspicious. A post-mort examination will happen today to find out exactly why the baby died.

Gordon Taylor, the head of the players' union, says Raheem Sterling is not being disloyal to Liverpool by delaying contract talks until the summer. The 20-year-old English player has been offered a huge deal, believed to be £100,000 a week, by manager Brendan Rodgers, but the two sides have not been able to agree on terms. Sterling has said he is not just interested in money, and Taylor thinks it might be smart to wait until the season ends before continuing the discussions. Sterling admitted in a TV interview that he is not ready to sign a new contract with Liverpool.

It has been a difficult time for former Manchester United player Anderson since he returned to Brazil. On Wednesday, his own mistakes were overshadowed by a teammate’s foolish behavior. Anderson was sent off during Internacional’s 1-1 draw in Porto Alegre. He committed a foul on the field without the ball, shoving Otacilio Neto, a striker from Erechim. Neto was also sent off for hitting Anderson with his elbow. However, Anderson’s teammate Fabricio drew more attention by swearing at his own fans. Fabricio received a red card, making him the third player sent off. This left Internacional with only nine players on the field.

A seven-year-old boy was attacked by two teenagers while he was out buying food. The two youths took the boy to a remote place and raped him. When the boy fought back, they set him on fire, Inspector Sasthe told PTI. The boy suffered burns over 30 percent of his body, but he managed to escape, Sasthe added. The incident happened in Pagma Nagar, a neighborhood in Bhiwandi City, which is a suburb of Mumbai. The police are now investigating the case.

Dug, a pug, has recovered after being bitten in the face by a rattlesnake. Dug and his owner, Lindsay Castro, were hiking on the Jurupa Hills trail in Fontana, Canada, on Thursday. They heard a rattling sound. Lindsay moved back, but Dug ran toward the snake. The snake bit Dug in the face. Dug’s face swelled up to twice its normal size.

Alvaro Arbeloa, a defender for Real Madrid, says that Jose Mourinho could return to manage the team in the future. Mourinho was the manager of Chelsea at the time of this statement. He managed Real Madrid for three years until 223, when he left to return to Chelsea. his departure was messy and involved arguments with top players like Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos, and Pepe. Arbeloa, who has played 25 times for the team this season, says Real Madrid would always consider hiring the Portuguese coach again.

On Saturday, Liverpool’s hopes of reaching the Champions League ended at the Emirates Stadium. Manager Brendan Rodgers admitted this during his 15-minute press conference. It was clear that his team’s chances were gone.

 Rodgers tried to remain positive, but he did not hide that it has been a difficult season. Last year, Liverpool fought hard for the title, but this year they have fallen out of the race. It is a hard reality for a club that thought it was returning to success. Even though the season has been tough, it still feels like Liverpool are moving forward under Rodgers.

Inter Milan coach Roberto Mancini was angry because his team drew 1-1 at home against Parma, a team near the bottom of the league. He cancelled their day off and called them in for an early morning training session on Sunday. The team trained at 8:30 a.m. local time. Club vice-president Javier Zanetti and sporting director Piero Ausilio watched the practice. Mancini was upset with his players’ attitude after the Saturday draw. The draw left Inter Milan tied for ninth place with Genoa, 10 points behind the spots that qualify for European competitions. Inter Milan confirmed on their website that the first team trained on Easter Sunday.

Many fans want to buy rare items that used to belong to their favorite players or teams. small pieces of history can sell for thousands of pounds. You might be surprised to hear that an expired passport of Paul Parker, a famous right back for Manchester United and England in the 1990s, was listed on eBay for £5,000. The item was listed in early March and the bidding ended on Tuesday, but it is not clear if anyone actually paid the large amount.

People have seen images of Jesus on toast, pancakes, crisps, and ice cream. But a builder named Paddy Morrall was surprised when he saw a image of Jesus on a piece of wood in Inverness, Scotland. Paddy, 31, from Keighley, near Bradford, saw the image on a broken scaffolding board on Wednesday. The image showed Jesus in a full-length robe. The image appeared after the wood was left out in the rain for several hours. Paddy has kept the board.

On Tuesday, Slovakia beat the Czech Republic 1-0 in a friendly soccer match. Ondrej Duda scored the only goal in the second half. The 20-year-old midfielder kicked the ball low from outside the penalty area in the 49th minute. This was his second goal for his country. Slovakia has now won three of the ten games played against the Czech Republic since the two countries split in 1993. The Czech Republic has won five of those games. During the match, Slovakia’s Martin Skrtel kicked Czech Republic’s Daniel Kolar in the face. Slovakia’s win continues their strong recent performance.

Karim Benzema, a star player for Real Madrid, showed that he has other talents besides football. He posted a video of himself rapping along to a song by Tupac while driving his Bugatti Veyron. This video came out as Real Madrid gets ready to play Granada at their home stadium, the Bernabeu, on Sunday. Benzema sang along to Tupac’s song "Check Out Time." Some people might have thought "All Eyez on Me" would have been a better song for him to use, especially since Benzema has scored 20 goals in all competitions this season. The video shows Benzema, who plays for both Real Madrid and France, singing along to Tupac in his Bugatti Veyron.

Harvey Boulter, a wealthy businessman who supports UKIP, is trying to stop a Conservative candidate named Tom Tugendhat from winning an election. Boulter is angry at the Conservative Party because he helped force Liam Fox to resign as Defence Secretary. He has already gave £30,000 to a UKIP candidate who is running against Fox in Somerset. Now, Boulter is spending another £30,000 to try to defeat Tugendhat, who is running for the Conservatives in Tonbridge and West Malling, Kent.

The game between Sheffield Wednesday and Huddersfield, which was called a Yorkshire derby, ended in a 1-1 tie. Two goals were scored in the last four minutes of the match. Sergiu Bus, a substitute for Sheffield Wednesday, scored the first goal in the 86th minute. Ishmael Miller, also a substitute, scored an equal goal for Huddersfield just before the end of the game. This result means Huddersfield has not won any of their last seven games. They are now 18th in the league table, six places and nine points behind Sheffield Wednesday. Sergiu Bus was seen celebrating after he put Sheffield Wednesday ahead.

Stuart Dallas has come a long way since Mark Warburton signed him from a local park for £70 a week. The 23-year-old, who recently played well for Northern Ireland, scored two great goals as Brentford beat Fulham 4-1 on Good Friday. Brentford now looks ahead to their game against Nottingham Forest on Monday, hoping to do more than just qualify for the playoffs. Warburton first noticed Dallas three years ago playing part-time on a muddy field for Crusaders, his home team. Dallas celebrated his second excellent goal against Fulham on Good Friday. He has been a surprise success this season, helping Brentford move closer to the Premier League.

Baseball is America’s most popular hobby, so it’s no surprise that fans are very passionate about their favorite teams. The New York Yankees and Boston Red Sox are the biggest rivals, and they also have the most fans. The Texas Rangers and Atlanta Braves have many supporters in the South. The New York Mets, though, have fewer fans.

Trey Moses, a high school basketball star, made many people happy by asking a girl named Ellie Meredith to prom. Ellie has Down syndrome. Trey is a senior at Eastern High School in Louisville, Kentucky. He will play basketball for Ball State University next year. He volunteers with teenagers who have learning disabilities.

On Thursday, Trey surprised Ellie during her P.E. class. He gave her flowers and a sign that said, "Let's Party Like it's 1989." This is a reference to a song by Taylor Swift, who is Ellie's favorite singer.

Ellie said yes. She told CNN that she can't wait to go dress shopping because she has already told "a million people" about going to prom.

On April Fools' Day, President Barack Obama took a break from his duties to pretend to be Frank Underwood, the fictional president from the TV show *House of Cards*. Frank Underwood is a manipuous character played by Kevin Spacey, who has won an Oscar. The character often speaks directly to the audience in a style similar to Shakespeare. The president said, "Hello everybody. This is not Frank Underwood. This is Barack Obama. Happy April Fools' Day. Frank learned it from me." He also used a Southern accent to sound like the character.

Ludovic Obraniak, a midfielder for Caykur Rizespor, was taken to the hospital on Saturday because doctors worried about his heart. He was substituted from the game against Fenerbahce after only 30 minutes. The Polish international player had to leave early and go for medical tests. Caykur Rizespor announced on social media that preliminary tests showed he was not in immediate danger. Obraniak is currently on loan at Caykur Rizespor from the German team Werder Bremen. Moussa Sow scored a goal for Fenerbahce during their 5-1 win on Saturday.

On Easter Sunday night, a crash occurred on Warringah Road in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney. A 1973 E-Type Jaguar, worth more than $120,000, collided head-on with a Toyota Kluger 4WD at a traffic light intersection. The Jaguar was completely destroyed. All three people in the vehicles were taken to the hospital as a precaution, even though no one was injured. NSW police are still investigating the crash.

People in Shandong Province, China, have been carrying natural gas in plastic bags. Recent pictures from Lijin village in Dongying city show people using rickshaws to transport the gas in bags that are up to six metres long. The People’s Daily Online reported this. Passers-by are worried because the gas is highly explosive. They say it is like carrying a bomb, because even a small flame or a cigarette could cause a disaster. Local media say this is a common scene in some villages in Shandong. They believe this is a way for villages to save money on transportation costs.

Tiger Woods was seen practicing at Augusta National, which gives fans hope that he will play in this year’s Masters, the first major golf tournament of the season. Woods, a former world number one, has not played on the PGA Tour since February 5. He withdrew from the Farmers Insurance Open because his back pain returned. He has taken time off to try to get back in shape, but many people think he will return for the Masters, a tournament he has won four times. Woods was seen practicing at Augusta on Tuesday, and it is said that he has returned to the course. Woods has fallen out of the top 100 for the first time in almost 19 years.

The BBC is facing criticism for spending thousands of pounds of licence fee payers' money on a 44-page guide for staff on how to use emojis. The guide was commissioned by BBC executives, who hired an agency to research how smiley faces can be used in news stories and on social media. Emoji designers also created graphics of popular stars like Gary Lineker and Graham Norton. The BBC spent licence fee payers' money on this emoji guide before using a 'sad face' emoticon to report the death of the world's oldest woman.

Moses Kipsiro, a top distance runner who often trains with Mo Farah, says he is afraid for his life. Kipsiro won the 10,00m gold medal at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow last year. He says five female runners, as young as 15, came to him for help. They said their coach was sexually abusing them. Kipsiro reported the abuse to the police and his national running federation. Since then, he has received death threats.

Patrick Kluivert, a former Dutch football player and assistant coach, has started his job as head coach of Curacao with a win. Curacao, an island in the Caribbean, has advanced to the second round of qualifying for the 2018 World Cup. They drew 2-2 in the second game against Montserrat, winning 4-3 overall. Kluivert's team had won 2-1 on Saturday in Willemstad. Kluivert helped Curacao move to the next stage of the 2018 World Cup qualifying. He was an assistant coach for Louis van Gaal (center) at the 2014 World Cup.

Brady Eaves, an 18-year-old student, has been kicked out of his fraternity, dropped from college, and sent for a mental health evaluation. DailyMail.com revealed last weekend that Eaves, the stepson of a former candidate for governor in Mississippi, was the teenager in a video laughing while biting the head off a live hameter. The video was taken at a Spring Break party in Florida while everyone was drunk. Eaves could face felony animal cruelty charges, which could mean up to five years in jail and a $500 fine.

Sri Lanka’s sports minister, Navin Dissanayake, asked cricketer Kumar Sangakkara to reconsider his retirement from limited-overs cricket. He made this request on Wednesday. Sangakkara announced his retirement from one-day cricket on March 18. He was upset about losing in the World Cup quarter-finals. He said he was happy because Sri Lanka is in a better position now than when he started playing in 2000. Dissanayake made the request after naming a new temporary group to manage the sport. This group is led by former Test cricketer Sidath Wettimuny.

Edinburgh Rugby has called back three Scottish players for their European Challenge Cup quarter-final match against London Irish this Sunday. Dougie Fife, Alasdair Dickinson, and Ross Ford are returning to the team. They were rested from last week’s 26-15 win over the Scarlets in Llanelli. because they had just played for Scotland in the Six Nations tournament. Edinburgh’s head coach, Alan Solomons, wants to name his strongest team for the game at the Madejski Stadium. Fife is one of three Scottish players coming back to Edinburgh after playing for their country.

Chris Ramsey, the manager of QPR, says that Tony Pulis is one of the best coaches in Britain. but Ramsey’s team does not need to learn any tactics from him. Ramsey’s QPR plays against Pulis’s West Brom on Saturday at The Hawthorns. QPR is 19th in the Barclays Premier League. They are four points behind Sunderland, who are in 17th place. QPR has earned only four points since the start of the new year. They need a strong finish like Pulis had with Crystal Palace in 2013. Palace earned 17 points in their last eight games that season to avoid being relegated. Chris Ramsey praised Tony Pulis before their important match in the Premier League.

Silhan Ozcelik, an 18-year-old student, appeared in court accused of planning to travel abroad to fight with Kurdish rebels against the Islamic State. She was 17 when she disappeared from her Kurdish family’s home in north London last October. The Old Bailey heard that she traveled on the Eurostar with another man to Stuttgart, Germany, where the Kurdish Workers’ Party (PKK) youth movement has its headquarters. Ozcelik is accused of preparing to commit a terrorist attack in October 214.

Esteban Cambiasso, who plays for Leicester City, has won many important football trophies before. He says that keeping Leicester in the Premier League would be one of the best moments of his career. Cambiasso, who played for Argentina, won five league titles with Inter Milan and also won the Champions League in 2020. He told the BBC that avoiding relegation feels like winning another cup. He joined Leicester last summer for free and signed a one-year contract.

Crystal Palace manager Alan Pardew says Manchester City can still win the Premier League title, even if they are behind. City came back to win the league last season, and they won it in 212 too. In 212, Sergio Aguero scored a goal in the last minute of the final game, which helped City win on goal difference over Manchester United.

Chelsea is currently six points ahead of the other teams, and they have one game left to play. But Pardew, whose team plays against City on Monday, thinks the race is not over yet. Pardew has said that City still have a chance to win the title.

Hull City has asked the Football Association (FA) to change its name back to Hull Tigers. The FA had previously said no, by 47 votes to 27. This decision made many fans angry. They thought the fight was over. Now, the club’s boss, Steve Bruce, says the club is trying again. The club’s owner, Assem Allam, still wants to change the name, even though fans are upset. An arbitration panel has decided that Allam is allowed to make another application. If he succeeds, Hull City will become Hull Tigers.

John Bramblitt, a 42-year-old artist from Denton, Texas, became completely blind at the age of 30. He had epilepsy starting when he was 11 years old, which gradually took his eyesight over 19 years. 12 years after losing his sight, he discovered a love of painting. He can create amazing images using only his touch. He uses a special technique: he paints an outline using fabric paint, and then colors in the work.

Chelsea: Chelsea will decide late whether Diego Costa plays in Saturday’s match against Stoke. The striker hurt his hamstring during Chelsea’s recent win over Hull and missed time with the Spanish national team. Although he has recovered and is fit, the club may not risk playing him after the international break.

Rangers have lost all three league games against teams from Edinburgh this season. Stuart McCall, who manages Hearts, thinks his team should win at least one game when they play Rangers at Ibrox on Sunday. Hearts won 2-1 there last August, and Hibernian won 3-1 and 2-0 on their visits. Rangers boss Stuart McCall wants to beat an Edinburgh team at home this season. A 2-0 win against Hearts 12 days ago might have been a good sign for Rangers, who have been struggling to get promoted.

Celtic, who are trying to win three major trophies this season, played against St Mirren, who are struggling near the bottom of the league. many people expected an easy win for Celtic, but the game was exciting. Celtic won, but they showed that they cannot take their next title for free. In the Scottish Premier League match on Friday, Celtic winger Kris Commons took a shot on goal.

Ulster has signed Charles Piutau, a player from New Zealand. Piutau, 23, will join the team in July 2016 for two years. He can plays full back, wing, or centre. He has played 14 times for the New Zealand national team (the All Blacks). He made his first international game against France two years ago. Ulster team manager Bryn Cunningham said it is very exciting to get a player with Piutau's skills. Piutau has played for the Blues in New Zealand since 2012.

On a rainy day, Fiorentina beat Sampdoria 2-0. This win moved Fiorentina up to fourth place in the league with 49 points. Alessandro Diamanti, a former West Ham player, scored the first goal just after the 60th minute. Mohamed Salah, who is playing for Fiorentina on loan from Chelsea, scored the second goal two minutes later.

 Miralem Pjanic scored the only goal to help AS Roma beat Napoli 1-0 in Serie A on Saturday. This was Roma’s first win at home in over four months. Mohamed Salah kept scoring, as he did again in Fiorentina’s 2-0 victory over Sampdoria.

Juventus won 2-0 against Empoli on Saturday. This makes it four games in a row that they have been close to winning the Serie A championship. Carlos Tevez scored the first goal just before halftime. Roberto Pereyra scored the second goal at the very end of the game. Juventus now has 14 more points than the team in second place. There are nine games left in the season.

Kevin de Bruyne’s agent says that no deal has been made for the player to leave Wolfsburg this summer. However, he admitted that many clubs are watching the Belgian star. De Bruyne has become very popular in European football after playing well in the Bundesliga. He has been linked with Manchester City and Bayern Munich. Patrick De Koster, the agent, told FOCUS Online that many teams want De Bruyne, but no transfer has been agreed. He said, “There are always interested teams and there has been some informal contact.”

Swansea manager Garry Monk wants to win his first game of the season against Hull on Saturday. His team has had a great season so far. They are in eighth place, and they have more points than they ever had in their first season in the Premier League (211-12). They have eight games left. If they win five of those games, they will have more points than they did in 211-12. Monk is showing his striker, Bafetimbi Gomis, what to do during practice this week.

Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are famous rivals in modern soccer. Ronaldo, the 2002 World Cup winner, wants them to play on the same team. Ronaldo owns part of the Fort Lauderdale Strikers, a second-division team in the United States. He wants to make the team famous around the world. The former Barcelona and Real Madrid player said he wants the best players in the world to join his club. Ronaldo said he would pay from his own pocket to sign Lionel Messi. The Strikers are also trying to sign Cristiano Ronaldo.

Northampton rugby team says that George North, a player for Wales, will not play in the European Champions Cup quarter-final game against Clermont Auvergne on Saturday. because he has suffered another head injury. The team is waiting for a doctor’s advice before deciding when he can play again. North has been knocked unconscious three times in recent months, including during last Friday’s game against Wasps, which Northampton won 52-30. On Wednesday, a brain specialist examined him. Jim Mallinder, Northampton’s rugby director, said, “We won’t play him at the weekend.” Mallinder explained that North had a serious hit and was knocked out for a very short time.

Cesar Azpilicueta, a defender for Chelsea, believes his team will win the Barclays Premier League. He says that Chelsea has been the best team since the season started. The team is in first place, with six points ahead of Manchester City, who are their closest competitors. They have one more game to play than Manchester City. Chelsea will play Stoke City at their home stadium, Stamford Bridge, on Saturday. People have thought Chelsea would win the title for a long time, and Azpilicueta says this is because they started the season very well. In August, they won seven of their first eight games and took first place early on. Azpilicueta is looking forward to the rest of the season as Chelsea works toward winning the title.

Mohamed Diame will return to play for Hull City when they visit Swansea on Saturday. Hull manager Steve Bruce said that Diame, who plays in the middle of the field, will take part in the game at some point. Diame joined Hull from West Ham for £3.5 million this summer, but he has been injured for more than four months with a knee problem. Bruce said Diame is physically strong and very good, but he has been out for a long time with a bad injury. Diame’s return is good news for Hull because they are fighting to avoid being promoted out of the league.

Atletico Madrid’s sporting director, Jose Luis Perez Caminero, says that 26-yearish Belgian defender Toby Alderweireld will return to the club when his one-year loan at Southampton ends. Alderweireld has played well for Southampton this season. He has said before that he would like to stay in the Premier League permanently, and Tottenham is also interested in him. However, Atletico Madrid expects him to come back to Spain, along with another player, Oliver Torres, who is currently playing for Porto in Portugal.

Tom Carroll, a footballer for Swansea who is playing there on loan from Tottenham, will be out of action for up to six weeks because of an ankle injury. He hurt his ankle while playing for England’s Under-21 team in a 1-0 win against the Czech Republic last Friday. Carroll scored the only goal of the match, which took place in Prague. After he scored the winning goal, his teammates celebrated with him. Carroll has played 18 times for Swansea during his one-year loan from Tottenham.

Franck Ribery says he cannot play for Bayern Munich against Borussia Dortmund this week because he is still recovering from an injury. He admitted that he can barely even run. Ribery got hurt at the start of last month during a game against Shakhtar Donetsk. He had to leave the field walking. In that same game, his teammate Arjen Robben also got injured. However, Ribery hopes he will be ready to play in the German Cup quarter-final against Bayer Leverkusen in the middle of the week.

Bayern Munich captain Philipp Lahm might play in the Bundesliga game against Borussia Dortmund on Saturday. This is his first game since he hurt his ankle. Lahm has now fully recovered. Coach Pep Guardiola said on Friday that other players cannot play. Franck Ribery (ankle), Arjen Robben (stomach), Javi Martinez (knee), and David Alaba (knee) are all out. Guardiola is not sure if Holger Badstuber (hip) can play. Thiago Alcantara might play for a few minutes because he is still recovering from long-term knee injuries. Guardiola will not have many of his best players for the match against Dortmund.

Michael Duff, a long-serving defender for Burnley, thinks that manager Sean Dyche could become the England national team manager someday. Dyche, 43, has gained a good reputation since he started managing Burnley in October 2012. He was the former defender for Chesterfield who helped the team, which was expected to be relegated, achieve an unexpected promotion to the top league last season. Now, Duff, who is getting ready to play against Tottenham in the Premier League on Sunday, supports his manager Dyche’s potential future role with the England team.

Mauricio Pochettino, Harry Kane’s manager, has allowed Kane to play in the European Under-21 Championships this summer. Roy Hodgson, England’s coach, confirmed that Kane will be on Gareth Southgate’s team for the tournament in the Czech Republic. This happens even though Kane made his first appearance for the senior England team last week. Kane will also travel to Australia and Malaysia before the championships. Kane recently played for England against Italy, starting the game after coming off the bench and scoring a goal against Lithuania.

Alvaro Morata’s agent, Beppe Bozzo, says that Morata wants to stay at Juventus and does not want to return to Real Madrid. The 22-year-old player moved to Juventus last summer for £15.8 million. He had struggled to get regular playing time at Real Madrid. Morata signed a five-year contract with Juventus. During the 2113-14 season, he started only three games for Real Madrid in La Liga. Since moving to Turin, Morata has done well. He has scored seven goals in 22 Serie A matches this season.

Hundreds of thousands of football fans have travel problems this weekend because of Easter rail repairs. There are more than 30 Premiership and Championship games scheduled for the long weekend, but large parts of the rail network are closed for repairs. More than half of the games will have delays and problems, so fans must drive instead. This weekend’s big match, Arsenal versus Liverpool in London, will also be affected by the rail problems. The Labour Party says the Government failed to learn from the Boxing Day chaos, when nearly a million football fans had terrible journeys to follow their teams.

Grupo OAS, the company that owns Natal’s Dunas Arena, is selling the stadium because it has no enough money. The company also wants to sell half of its ownership of the Fonte Nova arena in Salvador. Grupo OAS has had money problems for months because of a corruption investigation into the state oil company Petrobras. This investigation made it hard for the company to get loans.

A group of U.S. senators wrote to FIFA, the world governing body for football, asking them to strip Russia of the 2018 World Cup hosting rights. The senators cited Russia's involvement in the Ukraine crisis and its occupation of Crimea. The letter, dated Tuesday and released on Wednesday, by 13 Democratic and Republican lawmakers strongly urged FIFA to move the tournament elsewhere.

Juan Arango, the captain of the Mexican soccer team Tijuana, apologized to another player after biting him. The game was a very intense match between Tijuana and Monterrey. With only a few seconds left, Tijuana was losing 4-3. Arango walked over to Monterrey’s player, Jesus Zavala, and bit him on the shoulder.

Arango, who is 4 years old, said, "I did something I shouldn't have done with Zavala." The video shows Arango biting Zavala’s shoulder. Zavala held his shoulder after being bitten. Zavala’s team won the game 4-3. Zavala showed the referee the mark on his shoulder from the bite.

Paul Merson started an argument with Andros Townsend again. Townsend played for Tottenham in a 0-0 tie against Burnley on Sunday. He came into the game with only seven minutes left. Merson wrote on Twitter: “Did you miss the coach? #RubberDub #7minutes.” Merson had made Townsend angry before. Cristiano Ronaldo’s decline is not as bad as people thought. The Real Madrid player scored five goals against Granada. This brings his total to 36 goals in La Liga this season. Most ads in newsagent windows are practical, like selling kittens or offering handyman services. But one man, who called himself John, used an ad to find a partner. John’s ad, written in black capital letters, asked for “a way of life with quality.” For him, this old-fashioned method worked better than internet dating.

The exciting match ended with both teams having only 12 players on the field because fights broke out. Jones-Bishop, who joined Salford from Leeds Rhinos recently, now has 7 tries this season, making him the team's top scorer. Salford was leading 12-8 at halftime. Jones-Bishop scored his try in the 60th minute, which helped Salford move up to third place in the league.

Pardew wrote a letter to Pellegrini to apologize for the bad word he used. On Monday, Pardew, who now manages Crystal Palace, will face Pellegrini and Manchester City again. Mils Muliaina, a former rugby star who won the World Cup with the All Blacks, has been released on bail after being arrested for suspected sexual assault. Muliaina, 34, denies the accusations. He was arrested last night after his team, Connacht, lost 14-7 to Gloucester in the quarter finals of the European Challenge Cup. Muliaina had been injured during the game when police approached him. The fullback, who has played 100 games for the All Blacks, was taken away by officers at Kingsholm Stadium in connection with an incident in Cardiff in March.

QPR players feel confident about their upcoming match against Aston Villa on Tuesday. This is a important game in the Barclays Premier League. QPR is still in 19th place, but they are only three points away from safety.

QPR coach Chris Ramsey told his players to stay calm during the 4-1 win against West Brom. Eduardo Vargas scored the first goal and celebrated with his teammates. Chris Ramsey said in a press conference on Monday: "It's a fantastic victory for us. The morale has been good, very professional."

Wenger probably won't put Diaby in that important game, but he said Diaby might get a new contract, possibly one that pays him based on how much he plays.

The absence of Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy has never been an issue for the Shell Houston Open in Humble, a small suburb near Houston. Record crowds have come to the event, which is the last tournament before the Masters. The tournament has been a huge success thanks to the popular play of Phil Mickelson and local favorite Jordan Spieth.

18 months ago, Spieth, who was only 21 at the time, was criticized for quitting college to join the PGA Tour. He was ranked 809th in the world at the time. Now, at 21, he is ranked number four in the world. Interestingly, no one is criticizing him anymore.
